,(a) ਇਹ ਅੱਜ ਤੱਕ ਨਗਰਪਾਲਿਕਾ ਬਕਾਏ ਲਈ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਇੱਕ ਬਕਾਇਆ ਨਹੀਂ ਸਰਟੀਫਿਕੇਟ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਇਹ ਇਮਾਰਤ ਨਿਯਮਾਂ ਦੀ ਪਾਲਣਾ, ਜ਼ਮੀਨ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਤਬਦੀਲੀ, ਕਿਸੇ ਵੀ ਅੱਗ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਆ ਨਿਯਮਾਂ ਜਾਂ ਕਿਸੇ ਵੀ ਐਕਟ/ਨਿਯਮ ਅਧੀਨ ਕਿਸੇ ਹੋਰ ਪਾਲਣਾ ਨੂੰ ਨਿਯੰਤ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ।

The owner shall ensure proper space, accommodation, food and medical treatment to the dog.

The owner shall keep the dog protected by getting it vaccinated against Rabies from a Govt. Veterinary Practitioner or Veterinary Practitioner duly registered with Indian Veterinary Council (IVC) or State Veterinary Council (SVC).
The owner shall keep the dog chained/ leashed while taking it outside. All ferocious dogs shall be duly muzzled and a stick shall be carried by the escort accompanying the dog while taking it out.
The owner shall ensure that the dog will wear a collar affixed with the metal token issued by the Registration Authority at all times.

The owner shall not indulge in breeding of dogs for commercial purposes and trading of dogs within the area of Municipal Corporation. In case it is found that the dog is being kept for breeding or trading/commercial purposes, the Registration Authority shall impound the dog(s) besides imposing a fine as fixed by the Municipal Corporation, SAS Nagar.

The owner shall not allow the dog to defecate in public places such as residential areas, green belts, parks, streets, roads, road berms and other common places. In case the dog defecates in the above-specified places, the owner shall clean the excreta at his/her own level.
